annotation.authors_or_issuer: Group of Governmental Experts on Emerging Technologies in the Area of Lethal Autonomous Weapons Systems, CCW (UN)
key_provisions_or_claims: IHL continues to apply fully to the development and use of LAWS
LAWS must not be used if incapable of compliance with IHL
Human control is needed to uphold IHL principles of distinction, proportionality and precautions
States should limit target types, duration, geographic scope and scale, and train operators
Legal weapons reviews required for new weapons; voluntary best-practice exchange encouraged
annotation.summary_en: Consensus report of the 2023 CCW Group of Governmental Experts on lethal autonomous weapons systems. It records organisation and participants and adopts conclusions that IHL fully applies, LAWS incapable of IHL compliance must not be used, human control is needed, and states should limit targets and operations. It recommends deciding future work modalities.
